Brutally honest corner

FAQ

Something we haven't covered? Call or WhatsApp us — a real person picks up.

Why don't you deliver every day?

Because daily delivery for heavy groceries is inefficient and expensive. Every "daily delivery" app charges you for the delivery bike, the fuel, and the driver — they just hide that cost in inflated food prices. We prefer to invest that money into the quality of your food rather than fuel for a delivery bike. You plan your pantry; we pass the savings directly to you.

How can I verify your certification?

Transparency is our core value. Our products carry the PGS-India "Organic" or "Green" logo, and every batch is validated by the Ministry of Agriculture's PGS portal. You can enter any farmer ID or batch code directly on the government portal to see their certification history. No middlemen, no unverifiable claims.

Do you sell vegetables or dairy?

No. We specialise in non-perishables — staples (rice, pulses, millets) and cold-pressed oils. This is a deliberate choice. Perishables require cold chains, preservatives, or rapid delivery — all of which compromise organic integrity. By focusing on non-perishables, we ensure that the quality and organic purity of every gram we sell is 100% controlled and uncompromised.

I found grain worms in my pack. Is that normal?

Yes, and it is a certificate of authenticity. A weevil's presence confirms the absence of the neurotoxic fumigants used in "perfect" supermarket bags. We cannot use chemicals to keep them at bay — that's part of what makes our products genuinely authentic. Our small-batch packs are designed for one month's use to naturally minimise this. Embrace the reality: you are eating food that is capable of supporting life.

Is the PGS-India certification as good as NPOP?

PGS-India is a government-regulated organic certification designed specifically for the domestic market — it has the same soil and farming standards, but eliminates expensive third-party audit fees, making it more affordable. NPOP is primarily the export-grade certification. The Government of India is currently streamlining recognition between both systems.

Can I place an order without ordering online?

Absolutely. You can call or WhatsApp us at +91 8988 5988 99 to place your order, ask about any product, or simply ask any of your queries. We're happy to help the old-fashioned way.
